description: This script calculates a random time interval for rebooting a device, either by generating random hours, minutes, and seconds or by selecting a random time within a specified maintenance window. It then sleeps for that interval before triggering a crash simulation and log backup.

methods.name: calcRandTimetoReboot
methods.description: Calculates a random time to reboot based on random hours, minutes, and seconds, then sleeps for that duration before triggering log backup.

methods.name: calcRandTimetoReboot_CBR
methods.description: Calculates a random reboot time within a maintenance window retrieved via dmcli, then sleeps until that time before triggering log backup.
